facts.label: Active retail dispensary licenses statewide
facts.source: Nevada Cannabis Compliance Board, Cannabis Establishment List, July 2026
facts.verify: Sheet 'ACTIVE LICENSE LIST', rows where LicenseType = 'Retail Dispensary'. 349 active licenses of all types.

facts.label: Active retail dispensaries in Clark County (Las Vegas), 71 percent of the state
facts.source: Nevada Cannabis Compliance Board, Cannabis Establishment List, July 2026
facts.verify: Filter active Retail Dispensary rows to County = CLARK: 75 of 105. Washoe (Reno) has 16, Carson City 3, and no other county exceeds 2.
facts.note: The file records county, not city, so Clark County is the correct unit. Do not attribute all 75 to the City of Las Vegas: Clark also contains Henderson, North Las Vegas and Paradise, where much of the Strip actually sits.

facts.label: Distinct operators holding Clark County dispensary licenses
facts.source: Nevada Cannabis Compliance Board, Cannabis Establishment List, July 2026
facts.verify: Distinct LicenseName among active Clark Retail Dispensary rows. Statewide 64 operators hold the 105 dispensaries; the largest, Deep Roots Harvest and Arboretum NV Permitco, hold 6 each.

facts.label: Active cannabis consumption lounge licenses
facts.source: Nevada Cannabis Compliance Board, Cannabis Establishment List, July 2026
facts.verify: Sheet 'ACTIVE LICENSE LIST', LicenseType = 'Retail Lounge': MM Development Company, Cheyenne Medical Sammy Davis RD263, and TGIG LLC. All three in Clark County.

facts.label: Consumption lounge licenses conditionally approved and not yet open
facts.source: Nevada Cannabis Compliance Board, Cannabis Establishment List, July 2026
facts.verify: Sheet 'CONDITIONAL LICENSES', LicenseType = 'Retail Lounge': 23 rows, of which 21 are Clark County, plus one Washoe and one each in Nye and Storey.
facts.note: The single most actionable fact on this page. The category is set to grow from 3 to as many as 26, almost entirely in Clark County, and search competition for lounge queries is close to nonexistent today.

facts.label: Retail dispensary licenses conditionally approved and not yet open
facts.source: Nevada Cannabis Compliance Board, Cannabis Establishment List, July 2026
facts.verify: Sheet 'CONDITIONAL LICENSES', LicenseType = 'Retail Dispensary': 23 rows. Clark 5, Washoe 4, Douglas 2, Eureka 2, remainder spread.

facts.label: Licenses surrendered or revoked, all types, cumulative
facts.source: Nevada Cannabis Compliance Board, Cannabis Establishment List, July 2026
facts.verify: Sheet 'SURRENDERED-REVOKED LICENSES': 166 rows, 147 surrendered and 19 revoked.
facts.note: IMPORTANT: only 2 of the 166 are Retail Dispensary. The shakeout hit the supply chain, not retail: 50 medical cultivation, 37 retail cultivation, 26 medical production, 19 retail production, 18 distributors. Do not present this as dispensary attrition.

facts.value: cultivation 106, dispensary 105, production 84, distributor 42, laboratory 8, lounge 3, medical dispensary 1

gaps: City-level dispensary counts: the CCB file records county only. Las Vegas, Henderson, North Las Vegas and Paradise cannot be separated from it. A Las Vegas city page needs a different source.
Visitor volume: the tourism argument for this market is real but no visitor figure is sourced here. Do not publish one without an LVCVA citation.
Tax rate: Nevada levies a wholesale and a retail excise tax. Not yet sourced to a Department of Taxation page. Do not publish a rate without one.

Las Vegas city page: still blocked as of 2026-08-24 (second full hunt). CCB Cannabis-Establishment-List-08.01.26.xlsx is county-only (County column = CLARK; sheets ACTIVE/CONDITIONAL/SURRENDERED-REVOKED, no address or city field). City of Las Vegas ArcGIS layers DO carry city-proper counts (Cannabis_Establishments/FeatureServer/98: 46 records, 20 Retail Cannabis Store, 11 Medical Cannabis Dispensary, 43 active) but the layer's lastEditDate is 2023-05-08 and the live Business_Licenses_View layer stopped updating 2023-12-20, so both are too stale to publish.

Nevada county-level or city-level cannabis SALES: not published. tax.nv.gov marijuana-statistics pages now resolve to a generic page with no reports, and ccb.nv.gov publishes no sales file. Do not cite Nevada sales figures.

If the City of Las Vegas refreshes its cannabis ArcGIS layer (check editingInfo.lastEditDate on Cannabis_Establishments/FeatureServer/98), a Las Vegas page becomes buildable: the honest angle is that the Strip is unincorporated Clark County, not the City of Las Vegas, so city-proper counts and metro counts differ by design.
